question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

We are _______ of flour. So, we have to buy the bread.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"out"** means having no more of something left; it indicates a lack or shortage. (बाहर/खत्म)

 
 
• **Example:** We are **out** of milk, so we need to buy some more.
 
 
 
• **"out"** refers to the state of not having any more of something. (बाहर/खत्म)
 
 
• **Example:** The store is** out **of stock on that particular item.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **by** (द्वारा): Used to identify the agent performing an action.

 
 
• **Example:** The book was written by a famous author.
 
 
 
• **in** (में): Used to indicate inclusion within a space, place, or limits.
 
 
• **Example:** He is in the kitchen.
 
 
 
• **up** (ऊपर): Toward a higher place or position.
 
 
• **Example:** She climbed up the ladder.
